title: Launch a coin by asking Grok
blurb: Say a name and a ticker. Grok puts your coin live on pump.fun.

parts.note: Cover image — goes in the cover slot at the very top, not in the body.

parts.html:
You already talk to Grok. Now it can launch your coin.

Say a name and a ticker. Grok puts it live on pump.fun.

Set it up once

Tap one button on Grokpad. You get a private connector link and your own launch wallet. No sign-up, no forms.

Paste the link into Grok’s Connectors. Send a little SOL, just what you’ll launch with. A launch costs about 0.02 SOL.

Then just ask

“Launch a coin called Moon Cat, ticker MCAT, about a cat on the moon.”

Grok writes the description if you skip it, launches from your wallet and sends back the pump.fun link. No wallet pop-ups.

Check your balance, sell or withdraw the same way.

80% of the fees are yours

Every trade of your coin pays a creator fee. 80% goes to your wallet, 20% to Grokpad.

The split is written into pump.fun’s own fee program at launch. Nobody can change it, us included. Payouts run on their own.

Say it. It’s live.

Get your link at grokpad.org

What’s the first coin you’d ask Grok for?
